title: Builders in Madhavaram: Building Fresh on Open Plots

seo.metaTitle: Builders in Madhavaram | Build on Open Plots | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Building on an open plot in Madhavaram? We check patta, layout approval and the access road, then plan water, sewerage and power before building. Get a quote.

excerpt: Madhavaram still has empty plots, so many projects here start fresh instead of demolishing first. This guide covers the documents, services and plinth decisions that take demolition’s place on the list.
faqTitle: Building in Madhavaram: questions owners ask

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Madhavaram?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. On an empty Madhavaram plot there is usually no demolition or narrow-lane premium. Instead we list services such as a borewell, a septic arrangement and a new electricity connection separately.

faqs.question: Who approves a new house in Madhavaram?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Madhavaram, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. We prepare the drawings and handle the submission, with the approval fees quoted separately.

faqs.question: When should I apply for an electricity connection on a new plot?
faqs.answer: Early. A new service connection has its own application and its own timeline, so it is best started alongside design rather than when the site is ready for power.

faqs.question: What if there is no sewer connection at my Madhavaram plot?
faqs.answer: Then a septic arrangement is needed, and it takes space and design that both affect the layout. Confirm what is actually available at the plot before the floor plan is fixed.

faqs.question: Why does the access road matter for approval?
faqs.answer: The road to your plot should exist as a legal road, not just a track people use. That matters for building approval as well as for getting materials delivered, so we check it with the plot documents.
